name: confetti
title: Confetti
description: Paper confetti for the small victories. Strips, punched dots, stars, triangles, streamers and torn scraps, each a tiny drawing from the ink engine, thrown from a click, a state change or a function call. Nothing moves with reduced motion.

a11y: Confetti is decoration: the pieces are aria-hidden, never focusable, and click-through (pointer-events: none). Say what happened in words too (a toast, a status line): confetti alone tells a screen reader nothing.
Reduced motion (the OS setting, data-motion="reduced", or --ll-motion 0) throws nothing at all: no pieces, no layer.
Pieces are removed as soon as they have faded, and the layer with them; a burst can be canceled with the function it returns, and unmounting a Confetti layer clears its pieces.
Flight runs on the Web Animations API (off the main thread). Browsers without it simply show nothing.
